Title: HepG2 Toxicity (MMV Data)
Description: Predicts cytotoxicity in HepG2 liver carcinoma cells, the standard counter-screen for distinguishing genuine antiparasitic activity from general cell killing. Ersilia trained the models on IC50 measurements for 1,335 compounds after 72 hours of exposure, contributed by Medicines for Malaria Venture, applying two thresholds so that moderate and pronounced toxicity are separated. A single cell line reports direct cytotoxicity and does not anticipate organ-level or metabolism-dependent toxicity.
Interpretation: Probability of HepG2 cytotoxicity at IC50 cut-offs of 5 and 10 uM.
